name: Sotheby
bio: Archetype: AoE DoT, AoE HoT. ⌽ Skill 1 inflicts [Poison], Skill 2 applies [Cure]. Kit revolves around tick effects. ⌽ Ultimate procs all [Poison] and [Cure] stacks immediately for good burst damage/healing. ⌽ Synergy with "Blasphemer of Night" using [Poison] stacks. ⌽ No on-demand healing, must plan out heals, otherwise heals are okay.
